summary: Operator tooling, no router code change (ADR-0069). New router/install.sh (bash, LF, executable): options --prefix, --config-dir, --check, and for packaging/tests --root DIR (no root, apt or systemctl), --no-venv and --os-release FILE. Before any change it refuses without root (unless --root), on a distribution whose ID/ID_LIKE is not debian/ubuntu, without Python >= 3.11, or with an incomplete source folder; unknown options are refused. Missing apt packages (python3, python3-venv, python3-aiohttp, python3-yaml, python3-cryptography, curl, jq) are installed, or only listed with --check or --root. Program files are staged in a mktemp folder below the prefix and swapped (the package folder renamed aside, then removed), bytecode caches are not copied, units are copied to /etc/systemd/system and systemd is reloaded; the configuration folder is created 0750 and never written. The venv uses --system-site-packages plus requirements-session.txt (includes requirements.txt with paho-mqtt<2) and is checked by importing the packages. With a configuration it runs router.py --check --files under setpriv --inh-caps=-all --bounding-set=-all (as the ADR-0044 unit runs) and --posture; a failing check refuses with the program files installed and the service untouched. Without one it names router.py --init. Last line STATE: installed | checked | refused. .gitattributes gains *.cmd text eol=crlf so Set-UpdateKey.cmd is checked out with CRLF.

findings.evidence: A manual install had to create the venv and check the capability-less readability of configured files by hand; only the maintainer's deploy did both.
findings.resolution: install.sh performs and checks these steps; apt, systemctl and the venv are exercised only on a real machine.

tests.evidence: 3 tests OK: layout, 0750 configuration folder, upgrade without leftovers, --check, refusals, valid --init configuration passes with posture, broken configuration refused with program files kept.
